name: True Prophet
overview: Scripture reveals that a true prophet is one whom the LORD reveals Himself to through visions or dreams and who speaks only the words commanded by God, as seen in Numbers 12:6 and Deuteronomy 18:18. God promises to raise up a Prophet like Moses, from among the brethren, whose words must be heeded (Deuteronomy 18:15). The authenticity of a prophet is confirmed by their fruit, warning believers to discern carefully since false prophets may perform signs and wonders to deceive even the elect (Matthew 7:16; Matthew 24:24). Any prophet who speaks presumptuously or in the name of other gods faces death, underscoring the seriousness of true prophetic authority (Deuteronomy 18:20).
